steps.move: Move funds to your spending wallet

text.move: Agents can spend from the spending wallet. You need to create a spending session with limits to allow them to do so. You are in control.
text.agent: Install an AI agent such as Claude or Codex on your computer, then open the agent terminal. You paste the Signet install command there in the next step. Without an agent installed, the command will not work.
text.install: Install Signet: run the command below in your agent terminal. Once you have an active SignetPass, click 'Get install code', then use the 'copy' icon to get the full installation command and paste it in your agent terminal. Watch the different examples in the tutorial to learn how to interact your agent with the SignetPass in different use cases.
text.connect: Installing the Signet CLI into your agent terminal will automatically register your agent to your SignetPass. Your agent is now ready to spend.
text.session: Control the spending of your agents within the limits of a spending session. You can define a budget, a max spending amount per transaction, a session time expiration. Spending sessions management is easy and flexible. You can create a spending session in advance and then let your agent spend autonomously when needed without your approval anymore. You can also let Signet propose you a spending session per default, matching with the expense the agent wants to spend to buy something. Get a notification on your Trellis wallet, review, adjust the amount if needed and approve. You have the control.
